turns.assessment: The fault is a common approximately 5.4 dB power loss at the input of the S21→S06 booster, propagated unchanged through every amplifier and seen on multiple channels. Stable pump currents rule against amplifier failure, while the loss already present at amp0 input rules out the downstream span. Recent work at S21 and the soft, all-channel loss pattern strongly identify contamination of the OMS input patch between the S21 ROADM degree and booster.

proposals.rationale: A dirty connector at the S21→S06 OMS input causes all-channel power reduction before the booster. This exactly matches the simultaneous ~5.4 dB input/output reductions across the amplifier chain, downstream channel-power and OSNR degradation, stable pump currents, and recent S21 maintenance.
